initial_events.content:
Run today's agentic AI tutoring session for Sviatoslava.

1. Check /mnt/session/outputs/lesson-log.json to find the next lesson in sequence (start at lesson 1 if the file does not exist).
2. Search the web for 2-3 fresh resources on today's topic (published in the last 30 days).
3. Write a clear, analogy-first lesson. One concept only.
4. If this is not lesson 1, write a 3-question quiz on the previous lesson's topic.
5. Write one interactive exercise with a model answer.
6. Send the full email to sviatoslava.zelikovska@gmail.com.
7. Update the lesson log and write output to /mnt/session/outputs/lesson-output.md.

Today is a new session — do not hard-code any dates. Use relative references only.

criteria: Email is delivered to sviatoslava.zelikovska@gmail.com by end of run
Lesson teaches exactly one new concept from the agentic AI curriculum in sequence
Quiz contains 3 or more questions grounded in the previous lesson (skipped on lesson 1)
Explanations use real-world analogies and plain language before any technical terms
At least one real article or resource from the last 30 days is cited with a URL
One interactive exercise with a model answer is included
